sections.text: Most people pay for four or five streaming services and only watch one. Pick your favorite. Cancel the rest. That alone saves about thirty dollars every month.
If you have not been to the gym in the last thirty days, you are donating money. Cancel it. Walk outside or use free YouTube workouts instead.
You are probably paying for iCloud, Google Drive, and Dropbox. You only need one. Pick the cheapest plan that fits your files and drop the rest.
Go to your phone settings, subscriptions. You will find at least two apps you forgot about, still charging you every single month. Cancel them now.
You do not need to pay for credit monitoring. Your bank and Credit Karma already give it to you for free. That is another fifteen dollars a month back in your pocket.
